attributes.summary: Baseline round, taken with the tracker refresh that retired the human review pipeline. Of 590 concepts, **216 are spec-verified** (47 Gold, 54 Solid, 19 Adequate, 96 Thin), 106 are consumed by at least one real block and 80 meet the two-consumer rule. The foundation carries the numbers: Kernel and Contracts are 55/95 and 55/87 verified, while Standards (10/56), Records (8/46) and Solutions (2/34) stay hollow. The single biggest quality gap is missing Spec examples — 120 verified specs have none, including the three most-consumed kernel commands (Validate Input, Resolve Relationship, Format Value), each one fixture away from Gold.
